chunks: And Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, when he saw the mihrabs in the mosques, would break them and say: “It is as though they are the altars of the Jews.”

key_terms.الْمَحَارِيبَ: prayer niches or recessed structures in mosques
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام
key_terms.مَذَابِحُ: altars or places of slaughter/sacrificial structures

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about mihrabs in mosques?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام disapproved of certain mihrab structures in mosques and likened them to the altars of the Jews. The report reflects concern for preserving the proper form and simplicity of mosque spaces in worship.
